note: Settled senses needed by the first planning pass. Expand only from the syllabus and reviewed Chemistry sources before authoring each affected topic.

terms.sense: The weighted mean mass of an atom of an element relative to one twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom.
terms.homonym_warning: Not the mass number of one isotope.

terms.sense: The amount of substance containing the Avogadro constant number of specified particles.
terms.homonym_warning: Always state which particles are counted.

terms.sense: The simplest whole-number ratio of atoms of each element in a compound.
terms.homonym_warning: Not necessarily the molecular formula.

terms.sense: The actual number of atoms of each element in one molecule.
terms.homonym_warning: It is a whole-number multiple of the empirical formula for a molecular substance.

terms.sense: The charge assigned to an atom by the agreed electron-accounting rules.
terms.homonym_warning: Not necessarily an actual ionic charge.

terms.sense: The enthalpy change when reactants and products are in their standard states under standard conditions.
terms.homonym_warning: The named process—formation, combustion or neutralisation—must also be stated.

terms.sense: The minimum energy that colliding particles must have for a reaction to occur.
terms.homonym_warning: On a Boltzmann graph it is a position on the energy axis, not an area.

terms.sense: A closed-system state in which forward and reverse reactions continue at equal rates, so concentrations remain constant.
terms.homonym_warning: Equal rates do not mean equal concentrations.

terms.sense: A substance that increases reaction rate by providing an alternative pathway of lower activation energy and is regenerated overall.
terms.homonym_warning: It does not change the equilibrium position.

terms.sense: An electron-pair acceptor.
terms.homonym_warning: Usually electron-deficient; do not define it only as a positive ion.

terms.sense: An electron-pair donor.
terms.homonym_warning: Its lone pair or negative charge is the reactive feature.

terms.sense: A species containing an unpaired electron.
terms.homonym_warning: The dot represents the unpaired electron.

terms.sense: A family of organic compounds with the same functional group and general formula, similar chemical properties and a gradual change in physical properties.
terms.homonym_warning: Successive members differ by CH2.

terms.sense: A compound with the same molecular formula as another compound but a different structural formula.
terms.homonym_warning: Different connectivity, not merely a different drawing.

terms.sense: A compound with the same structural formula as another but a different arrangement of atoms in space.
terms.homonym_warning: Includes cis-trans and optical isomerism in this syllabus.

terms.sense: Titre values that agree within 0.10 cm3 for this syllabus.
terms.homonym_warning: The rough titre is not used in the mean.

terms.sense: Unpredictable variation that causes repeated readings to scatter.
terms.homonym_warning: Repeating and averaging can reduce its effect.

terms.sense: An error that shifts readings consistently in one direction.
terms.homonym_warning: Repeating does not remove it.

terms.sense: The closeness of repeated measurements to one another and the resolution with which readings are recorded.
terms.homonym_warning: Not the same as accuracy.

terms.sense: The closeness of a measured or calculated value to the accepted value.
terms.homonym_warning: A precise set of readings may still be inaccurate.
